;Business and economy
*[[Impact of the COVID-19 pandemic on aviation]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Hubei]], [[COVID-19 pandemic in mainland China]]
***[[China]] resumes domestic flights to the [[Hubei]] province. [[Wuhan]] is expected to resume flights on April 8. [https://www.financialexpress.com/world-news/chinas-coronavirus-hit-hubei-province-begins-domestic-flights/1912878/ (''Financial Express'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]]
***[[Nepal Airlines]] will allow rescue flights to take stranded tourists back to their countries, but only if embassies requested it. [https://www.nepalitimes.com/latest/nepal-airlines-to-fly-stranded-australian-tourists-to-sydney/ (''Nepali Times'')]
*[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United Arab Emirates]], [[transportation in Dubai]]
**The [[Roads and Transport Authority (Dubai)|Dubai Roads and Transport Authority]] announces that the [[Dubai Tram]] and [[Dubai Metro]] will be suspended until April 5 as sterilization continues in [[Dubai]]. [https://gulfnews.com/uae/transport/coronavirus-dubais-rta-extends-8pm-to-6am-public-transport-suspension-until-april-5-1.70694418 (''Gulf News'')]
*[[Economic impact of the COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Michigan]]
***The 2020 [[North American International Auto Show]], originally scheduled from June 9–20 in [[Detroit]], has been cancelled due to the designation of the [[TCF Center]] as a temporary hospital. [https://www.clickondetroit.com/news/local/2020/03/28/2020-naias-cancelled-as-tcf-center-becomes-temporary-hospital/ (Click On Detroit)]

;Disasters and accidents
*An [[IAI Westwind]] jet, chartered by the [[Philippine government]] for a [[medical evacuation]] flight to [[Haneda Airport]] in [[Japan]], crashes upon takeoff at [[Ninoy Aquino International Airport]] in [[Manila]]. All eight people onboard are killed. [https://www.rt.com/news/484420-manila-medical-plane-crash/ (RT)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea–South Korea relations]], [[Japan–North Korea relations]], [[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]]
**[[North Korea]] fires two short-range [[ballistic missile]]s into the ocean, the latest in an unprecedented flurry of launches. Both [[South Korea]] and Japan condemn the launching. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-northkorea-missiles/north-korea-fires-more-missiles-than-ever-amid-coronavirus-outbreak-idUSKBN21F0Y2 (Reuters)]

;Politics and elections
*[[2020 Malian parliamentary election]]
**After having been postponed several times, [[Elections in Mali|parliamentary elections]] are being held in [[Mali War|war-torn]] [[Mali]]. The election is overshadowed by the recent kidnapping of the leading opposition politician [[Soumaïla Cissé]] and the first reported [[COVID-19 pandemic in Mali|COVID-19 death]] in the country. [https://www.dw.com/en/mali-election-underway-despite-coronavirus-fears/a-52949703 (DW)]
